prior_screening.separation: Later distinct source read after the earlier first/full-text passes and their integration, not a retrospective invention of another initial screener.

locators.finding: Within-subject voice categories: synthesised Watson, humanoid Sophia, and human speech; manipulation is voice rendering.

locators.section: Materials and Methods > Materials > Audio Stimuli
locators.finding: Five repeated interview-derived utterance types per voice category, including an imperative social-media phrase and a robot persona self-description; audio content originates from prior Sophia interview clips, not the participant's current task state.

locators.section: Materials and Methods > Materials > Voice Rating Measures
locators.finding: Participants judged perceived intelligibility, naturalness, trustworthiness, voice/speaker qualities and likability.
Online randomly presented clip-listening and speaker-impression survey; no participant-facing machine status or instructed operational response was tested.

hard_negative_cases.why_plausible: An isolated imperative phrase could appear to ask a listener to act.
hard_negative_cases.why_not_G01_here: The phrase is an interview excerpt used in a first-impression rating task; the experiment did not present it as a machine-issued task command, measure instruction compliance, or bind it to system/task state.

hard_negative_cases.why_plausible: An utterance about a robot being tireless or helpful might superficially resemble a system-status statement.
hard_negative_cases.why_not_G01_here: The phrase expresses a generic fictional/quoted persona characteristic, not an actual technical-system condition or a state-coupled request in the participant's task.

hard_negative_cases.why_plausible: The voice renderer is technical and audio representations are explicitly compared.
hard_negative_cases.why_not_G01_here: Production of sound by software is not sufficient; the frozen G01 definition also requires a system/task information or action-communication function.

limitations: Recheck was not blinded and was performed by another GPT-6 run, not an independent human reviewer.
Publisher HTML sections were consulted, but a PDF byte-matched manifestation, entire paper, figures, audio files and complete original interview context were not obtained in this pass.
Rule interpretation can be revised by a documented source contradiction; changes require source revision re-validation and coordinated canonical SCR history.
The historical 95 participants are reported by the source, not entered as an MHAC independent sample or outcome extraction.
